whyItMatters: A leaked a Shopify Admin API access token keeps working until the app is uninstalled or the token is rotated, so committed copies are high-impact even in old commits.
actions: Revoke the exposed token (uninstall the app or regenerate credentials in the Shopify admin).
Audit Admin API access logs for use of the exposed value.
Store the replacement outside version control (environment variable or secret manager) and rotate on any suspected exposure.
verification: After rotation, confirm the old value no longer authenticates (a request with it returns 401) and that a fresh secret scan of the repository reports no shpat_ shape.
